plan.summary: Base-building week. Easy runs on Monday and Tuesday, tempo session Thursday, gym sessions Friday and Saturday, long run on Sunday. Beach volleyball Friday evening for active cross-training.

sessions.description: Tempo run, 5 km at threshold pace

review.summary: Strong week with 32.0 km across 4 runs plus 2 gym sessions and beach volleyball. Anchored by a 17.6 km long run at 6:17/km with 106m elevation on Sunday. Solid tempo on Thursday at 4:48/km. Good variety with gym and volleyball adding cross-training stimulus.
highlights: 17.6 km long run with 106m elevation — strongest aerobic stimulus in 14 days
5.0 km tempo at 4:48/km shows solid speed development
Good cross-training variety with gym and beach volleyball
areas_to_improve: Easy run volume outside long run still low — add one 8-10 km easy day
Consider adding a rest day between gym and long run
